notes.title: Early Access Patch 1.02 - Radial skill menu and more controller support!
notes.content:
Hello loves,

The in-game skill menu has been replaced by a radial skill menu that can more easily be used by those who prefer to play with controllers. This wasn't a planned feature... I just couldn't figure out how to get the icon widgets in the skill menu to get and stay focused in-game. To the point that after many, many hours and failed attempts/workarounds I decided to just replace the menu entirely. As they say, sometimes the obstacle is the way.

I'm hoping that it works with steam decks.

So yeah, next focus will be the horde wave mode, which I will be seeing if I can incorporate co-op, most likely can as player hosted matches are already set up. I hope to get this feature out to you all, at least in it's first basic form, next week.

Thanks for your support, have a good weekend, and happy cinco de mayo.

B

notes.title: Early access soft launch - patch 01 - The joystick fix
notes.content:
Hello loves,

Brian here, fixed a couple bugs and made some improvements for todays patch. The right joystick was firing skill slot 4,  somehow it ended up being in the keybind map. There have been some minor improvements to the on screen keyboard for those playing with a controller. Also You can now select loadouts in the lobby.

It seems that the xp bar is not updating after a match so that's on the bug list for sure. I plan on adding glyphs to the skill bar for players who like to use controllers so they can better understand the gamepad layout.

As always, let me know if you have any suggestions, requests, or questions. 

B

notes.title: Movement Updates
notes.content:
Several improvements to movement have been made and are ready for testing in the offline alpha testing demo, including wall running.

Keybindings have also been added since the last update mentioned on Steam.

improved dodge system
aerial directional dash
sprint no longer costs stamina (testing it out)
ymirs horn cooldown now shows in toolbar
increased slide window
reduced passive health regen
collision mesh improvements
crouching now slows movement
added new voice overs featuring Brello
login as guest

moved register popup to be behind the play button (slightly less annoying)

Thanks for the feedback, more updates on the way.
